recipe_resolution_scope: Author preprocessing from structured MAT input through classifier tensor is resolved. Actual upstream MAT/GDF equality has been diagnostically checked for A01 only; remaining eight participants are a session-02 gate.
checkpoint_family: complete official results/saved models/run-1 set; A01-A09; no best-per-subject substitution

provenance_evidence.revised_log_matches: main_TrainValTest.py (T split, val_loss checkpoint, one run, E reported after training)
provenance_evidence.current_run_manifest: results/best models.txt lists run-1 for A01-A09
provenance_evidence.competing_legacy_path: main_TrainTest.py uses E as validation for checkpoint epoch and run selection; no exact H5-to-log receipt proves which invocation created current files
provenance_evidence.grade_reason: B: T-only revised path is supported by repository chronology/log, but exact checkpoint selection history is unresolved; legacy E-guided path exists.

native_recipe.expected_recording: author-format structured AxxT.mat/AxxE.mat with data entries; not a label-only E MAT
native_recipe.trial_start_semantics: Use stored a_trial integer directly as Python start; do not subtract one.
native_recipe.artifact_policy: all_trials=True; do not exclude nonzero artifact flags
native_recipe.filtering: none in this BCI load path
native_recipe.rereference: none in this BCI load path
native_recipe.shuffle: training and testing arrays/labels shuffled independently together with sklearn.utils.shuffle(random_state=42) before standardization
native_recipe.normalization: Per channel j, StandardScaler.fit on X_train[:,0,j,:] shaped [n_trials,1125]; per-timepoint mean/scale across all T trials; apply same T stats to T and E.
native_recipe.normalization_split_exposure: For revised recipe, scaler fit to all T trials before 80/20 T split; covariance validation T trials contribute to scaler.

native_mat_origin.remaining_subjects: A02-A09 not present in session-01 audit assets; session02 gate

A01_gdf_diagnostic.observed: All retained native MAT windows X[trial+375:trial+1500,:22] align to GDF [marker+376:marker+1501,:22].
A01_gdf_diagnostic.interpretation: Preserve source loader offset: it starts one sample after the zero-based GDF marker (4ms). This was a diagnostic; session02 must declare acceptance tolerance before parity checks.
A01_gdf_diagnostic.run_structure: 9 runs; first 3 have no trial annotations; last 6 have 48 each; each MI class occurs 12 times per run.

runtime_proposal.keras: TensorFlow bundled tf.keras; no standalone keras pin
runtime_proposal.status: proposed; supervisor provisioned separately; native load/forward/gradient parity not yet accepted
runtime_proposal.reason: HDF5 metadata records Keras 2.4.0 but does not identify exact TensorFlow version; TF2.15.1 preserves legacy tf.keras API without a framework port and supports the available Python 3.11 interpreter.
